what: When the panel passes the screen’s center line, two circles (labels inside) that sat apart touching both panel ends approach each other over 2s with cubic in-out until they overlap by 42% of the diameter, and accent-colored sand-grain dots (153 grains per 48px cell) show only inside the overlapping lens — a story of two things meeting, like ”Design × Technology”, in a single picture.

options.spread: Initial spread (to the edge of the board = 100), default 100
options.size: Circle size (% of panel height), default 100
options.label-shift: Extra px the label moves outward on approach (negative moves inward), default -4
options.replay: With true, it restarts from the beginning each time it leaves the screen and re-enters
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Two name tags (left, right) — text is redrawn inside the image and the original element is hidden for screen readers

from.where: about.html [data-slot=venn] — original Framer code component: overlap 42 · spread 100 · size 100 (phone 88) · duration 2 · easeInOutCubic · grainDensity 13 · grainSize .7 · labelOffset −4 · plays once after passing screen center (rootMargin −50%)
